Babylon A.D

programme.desc: Casanova es un maestro de la trampa y la seducción. Ninguna mujer se le resiste hasta que es rechazado por una hermosa dama llamada Francesca. Para alcanzar su amor, Casanova arriesgará su reputación e, incluso, su propia vida.
programme.title: Casanova

programme.desc: El partido de tenis de 1973 entre la campeona mundial femenina Billie Jean King y el ex campeón masculino y buscavidas serial Bobby Riggs se convirtió en uno de los eventos deportivos televisados más vistos de todos los tiempos.
programme.title: La batalla de los sexos
Battle of the Sexes

programme.desc: Junto a su grupo de Gladers, Thomas debe entrar en la legendaria Last City, el laberinto más mortífero de todos, que es manejado por la organización CRUEL. Quien salga de ahí con vida conocerá la verdad acerca de los laberintos.
programme.title: Maze Runner: La cura mortal
Maze Runner: The Death Cure

programme.desc: With his ballet ‘Toulouse-Lautrec’, Kader Belarbi, choreographer and director of dance of the Théâtre du Capitole of Toulouse, uses the work of the French artist Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec (1864-1901) to craft a new dialogue between painting and dance, impressively reviving the artist and his works. Among the performers of the Ballet du Capitole are Ramiro Gómez Samón, Alexandra Surodeeva, Natalia de Froberville, Marlen Fuerte Castro, and Solène Monnereau. This performance was recorded at Théâtre du Capitole in Toulouse, France, in October 2021.
programme.title: Toulouse-Lautrec

programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff.
programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Sonata for Cello, Op. 19

programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. Soprano Claron McFadden features as the soloist, presenting a selection of Gershwin’s classic jazz songs. Pianist Bart Van Caenegem is the soloist in Gershwin’s celebrated Rhapsody in Blue. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.
programme.title: Gershwin - Greatest Hits

programme.desc: In this documentary, Ludwig van Beethoven’s ‘Symphony No. 5’ is discussed. The piece has the character of an appeal from the very start, when the four-note “fate” motif casts a spell on listeners.
programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Beethoven No. 5

programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.
programme.title: Mozart - Sonata in D major - III. Molto allegro

programme.desc: This unique production of Carl Maria von Weber’s 'Der Freischütz' was created to celebrate both the piece’s 200th premiere anniversary at Konzerthaus Berlin and the 200th anniversary of the famed concert hall itself. Christoph Eschenbach conducts Konzerthausorchester Berlin and Rundfunkchor Berlin in this 2021 performance.
programme.title: Von Weber - Der Freischütz

programme.desc: Roberto Giordano performs Chopin's Ballade No. 1, Op. 23. The sketches of the work date back to 1831 during Chopin's eight-month stay in Vienna. The first ballade was completed in 1835 after the composer moved to Paris. The work gained popularity after appearing on the soundtrack to the 2002 Roman Polanski film The Pianist, where it is played by Janusz Olejniczak.
programme.title: Chopin - Ballade No. 1, Op. 23

programme.desc: Pianist Jakub Kuszlik (Poland, 1996) performs Reflets dans l’eau from Claude Debussy’s Images (book I), and Frédéric Chopin’s Sonata No. 3 in B minor, Op. 58, during the first round of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). This performance was recorded at the Bourgie Hall of the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.
programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 – First Round: Jakub Kuszlik

programme.desc: Frédéric Chaslin leads the Orchestre Symphonique Région Centre-Val de Loire/Tours and the Choir of Opéra de Tours in a performance of Gaetano Donizetti’s comic opera Don Pasquale (1842). Among the soloists are Laurent Naouri (Don Pasquale), Florian Sempey (Malatesta), Sébastien Droy (Ernesto), Anne-Catherine Gillet (Norina), and François Bazola (notary). This performance was recorded at Opéra de Tours, in 2021.
programme.title: Donizetti - Don Pasquale

programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the marvelous Berliner Philharmoniker and performs Johann Sebastian Bach's splendid St. John Passion. The solo voice parts are sung by the renowned soloists Juliane Banse, Michael Chance, Ian Bostridge, Rainer Trost and Thomas Quasthoff. Also joining is the famous RIAS Kammerchor.
programme.title: Bach - St. John Passion

programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 3 in D major, Op. 18 No. 3; String Quartet No. 11 in F minor, Op. 95, “Quartetto Serioso”; and String Quartet No. 8 in E minor, Op. 59, No. 2, "Razumovsky". This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on November 23, 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets Nos. 3, 8 & 11

programme.desc: Jeffrey Tate conducts the Mozarteum Salzburg Orchestra in a performance of Mozart’s “Paris” Symphony No. 31 (K. 297). The composer used the clarinets for the first time in a symphony, having heard the new instrument earlier in Mannheim.
programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 31, K. 297

programme.desc: The Messiah (HWV 56) by Georg Frederich Handel, tells the life and suffering of Christ: a story of passion, fire, and sacrifice. This performance of the Dutch ensemble Ribattuta Musica under the direction of conductor Dick Duijst was filmed in the grand church of the city of Ermelo, the Netherlands, in 2016.
programme.title: Handel - Messiah, HWV 56

programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. As part of the festival’s 2021 edition, Sir John Eliot Gardiner leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program that includes Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17, ‘Little Russian’, and Edward Elgar’s Variations on an Original Theme, Op. 36, better known as the Enigma Variations. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.
programme.title: Tchaikovsky Symphony 2 & Elgar’s Enigma Variations

programme.desc: Pianist Jakub Kuszlik (Poland, 1996) performs Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Piano Concerto No. 2 in C minor, Op. 18, during the final round of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). Kuszlik is accompanied by the Orchestre symphonique de Montréal under the baton of Xian Zhang. This performance was recorded at Maison symphonique de Montréal.
programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Final: Jakub Kuszlik

programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing.
programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde

programme.desc: Montréal native Marc-André Hamelin is internationally renowned for his musical virtuosity and refined pianism. He plays works by Haydn (Piano sonata in E major), Chopin (Piano sonata No.3), Debussy (‘Préludes’, book two), Hamelin (Etude No.7) and others.
programme.title: Legato - World of the Piano

programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28. This episode of ‘In Rehearsal’ offers an intimate look at the dialogue between Mehta and the musicians as they explore Strauss’s tone poem together.
programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta

programme.desc: Bass-baritone Matthias Hoffmann (Austria, 1991) and pianist Lisa Ochsendorf (Germany, 1991) perform works by Franz Schubert, Claude Debussy, Miroslav Srnka, Alphons Diepenbrock, Carl Loewe, Alexander von Zemlinksy, Reynaldo Hahn, Ralph Vaughan Williams, Wolfgang Rihm, Viktor Ullmann, and Robert Schumann, during the final round of the International Vocal Competition 2021 – Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at De Verkadefabriek in ’s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands.
programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Schubert, Hahn, Ullmann a. o.

programme.desc: With his third harpsichord book, Couperin discovered his own unique voice. The old-fashioned suite has had its day, the ordre reaches its peak. Although the number of sections per ordre is restricted, a powerful atmospheric description provides character and coherence. This legendary publication contains some of the most remarkable examples of Baroque keyboard repertoire: right up Bertrand Cuiller’s street.
programme.title: Couperin - Third book: A New Path

programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52.
programme.title: Prosseda performs Mozart, Schubert & Chopin

programme.desc: Kirill Karabits conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Mahler’s Symphony No. 4. Soloist is soprano Lucy Crowe. Recorded on December 8th, 2021.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4

programme.desc: House of Dreams is an imaginative concert designed by Alison Mackay. It is a magical journey to the meeting places of baroque art and music by Bach and Handel. The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra, who specialize in historical performance is directed by Jeanne Lamon.
programme.title: House of Dreams

programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 “Heroic”, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.
programme.title: Franck - Sonata for violin and piano

programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker plays Tchaikovsky's Fantasy Overture from "Roméo et Juliette", Mozart is his famous Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major K. 216 with violinist Frank Peter Zimmermann and Stravinsky's The Rite of Spring.
programme.title: Stravinsky - Le Sacre - I. L'Adoration de la Terre

programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Ludwig van Beethoven’s Violin Concerto in D major, Op. 61. Leading violinist Grimal is the soloist. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015.
programme.title: Beethoven - Violin Concerto, Op. 61

programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birthday, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 12. Written in 1837, the work is a set of eight piano pieces with contrasting moods. The work’s title is derived from one of the composer’s favourite authors’ collection of novellas: E. T. A. Hoffmann’s Fantasiestücke in Callots Manier.
programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 12

programme.desc: Bernard Haitink conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a rendition of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 4 in the Schauspielhaus in Berlin, in 1992. Soloist is soprano Sylvia McNair.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4

programme.desc: Misha Fomin performed romantic piano works at the Amsterdam Concertgebouw in November 2020. His recital opened with Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Sonatas No. 10 and 15 'Pastoral', followed by works of Frédéric Chopin, Johannes Brahms, and Franz Liszt.
programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw (2020)

programme.desc: Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuid in a performance of Richard Danielpour's Elegies. Soloists are Marina Prudenskaya (mezzo-soprano), Thomas Oliemans (baritone). Recorded at Muziekgebouw Eindhoven, The Netherlands, 2019.
programme.title: Danielpour - Elegies

programme.desc: This broadcast features ‘Iolanta’, a mature composition by Tchaikovsky, which was premiered in 1892. It contains all aspects of the composer’s mastery: beautiful melodies, clear structure, and genuine passion in its many varieties.
programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Iolanta

programme.desc: A joyously infectious performance of the Brandenburg Concertos by the Freiburg Baroque Orchestra demonstrates both the pleasure and the highest professional standard that can be reached with period instruments.
programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos

programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 7 in F major, Op. 59, No. 1 “Razumovsky”; String Quartet No. 13 in B-flat major, Op. 130; and the monumental Great Fugue, Op. 133. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on October 12, 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 7 & 13, and Op. 133

programme.desc: Anabel de la Mora is accompanied by the Orquesta Sinfonica de Minería conducted by Raúl Delgado in a concert program dedicated to Mexican composers. Recorded at the Academia de Música del Palacio de Minería, Mexico City in 2019.
programme.title: Mexican Concert - Part I

programme.desc: Pianist Antonio Chen Guang (China, 1994) joins the CMIM ensemble in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai – Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM).
programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Antonio Chen Guang

programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is consistently ranked as one of the best orchestras in the world. In 1990, orchestra members played beautiful chamber music, such as Ludwig van Beethoven's Octet in E-flat major and Antonin Dvořák's Serenade in D minor.
programme.title: Beethoven's Octet and Dvořák's Serenade

programme.desc: Every year at the end of August the renowned Early Music Festival takes place in the Dutch city of Utrecht. s part of this festival, Canadian fortepianist Anders Muskens performs a recital consisting of various sonatas by the German Baroque composer Franz Ignaz Beck, such as L’Éveillée and La Sophie. This performance was recorded at the Gertrudiskapel in Utrecht, August 25, 2020.
programme.title: Muskens performs sonatas by Franz Ignaz Beck

programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads his Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31, recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland, USA. In addition, Welser-Möst takes a walk through ‘his’ Vienna, enlightening us on this musical capital that was home to both Mozart and Schoenberg.
programme.title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg

programme.desc: The compelling documentary How to Get Out of the Cage (2012), by award-winning filmmaker Frank Scheffer, presents an intimate portrait of John Cage, one of the 20th century's most important composers.
programme.title: How to get out of the Cage - A year with John Cage

programme.desc: Audiences are captivated by the symphony's immense emotional journey, from the dark existential questioning to the triumphant, exhilarating affirmation of life in its famous choral finale. The sheer scale and dramatic power, combined with the profound spiritual and philosophical message of resurrection, create a profoundly moving and unforgettable concert experience.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2

programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 5 in A major, Op. 18, No. 5; String Quartet No. 4 in C minor, Op. 18, No. 4; and String Quartet No. 12 in E-flat major, Op. 127. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 17, 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 4, 5 & 12

programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht was all about 'England, my England'. In line with this festival theme, episode 1 of this two-part documentary offers a peek into the inner-city churches of Utrecht.
programme.title: England, my England - I

programme.desc: Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuid in a performance of Richard Danielpour's Elegies. Soloists are Marina Prudenskaya (mezzo-soprano), Thomas Oliemans (baritone). Recorded at Muziekgebouw Eindhoven, The Netherlands, 2019.
programme.title: Danielpour - Elegies

programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle and the London Symphony Orchestra mark 150 years since the death of Hector Berlioz with his tempestuous oratorio, La damnation de Faust.
programme.title: Berlioz - The Damnation of Faust

programme.desc: Manfred Honeck conducts the Berlin Philharmonic during the 2016 Easter Concert from Baden-Baden. Yo-Yo Ma is the soloist in Schumann’s Concerto for Cello, Op. 129. Also, on the program are Brahms Tragic Ouverture, Op. 81 and Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 6.
programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 6 in B minor, Op. 74

programme.desc: Compagnia Simona Bucci presents an extraordinary concert in scenic form: 'Preludi e Fughe - Geografia antropica'. Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87 inspired choreographer Simona Bucci to take on this project.
programme.title: Shostakovich - Preludes and fugues

programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 2 in G major, Op. 18, No. 2; String Quartet No. 16 in F major, Op. 135; and String Quartet No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 131. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 2, Op. 18, No. 2

programme.desc: English conductor and pianist Wayne Marshall leads the Orchestre national d’Île-de-France in a special concert celebrating classical music in film. The program includes works by composers as diverse as Gioachino Rossini, Richard Wagner, and Duke Ellington.
programme.title: Classical Film Music

programme.desc: Olivier Latry, the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame, plays Pierre Cochereau’s Boléro, Louis Vierne’s Carillon of Westminster and Scherzo from Symphony No. 2, Alexandre Guilmant’s Sonata No. 1, and more.
programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach

programme.desc: One night only! Welcome to the spectacular and decadent world of The Babylon Hotel, where music pours out of every crevice like bubbling champagne. In this concert, the upper class meets the underworld in a melting pot of euphoria and extravagance, nostalgia and pleasure with a carefree sinfulness only seen in the exuberant nightlife of the 1920s around the world. The concert features iconic music from movies and series, such as The Great Gatsby, Burlesque, and Babylon Berlin. The music is performed by the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and DR Big Band under the direction of Miho Hazama.
programme.title: The Babylon Hotel

programme.desc: Bernard Haitink conducts the Berliner Philharmoniker at the Easter Festival in Baden-Baden, 2015. On the program are Beethoven’s Symphony No. 6, and Violin Concerto, Op. 61. Isabelle Faust is the award-winning soloist.
programme.title: Beethoven - Violin Concerto, Op. 61

programme.desc: The Quarteto Radamés Gnattali performs Heitor Villa-Lobos' String Quartet No. 14. The quartet, existing of Carla Rincón (violin), Francisco Roa (violin), Fernando Thebaldi (viola) and Hugo Pilger (cello), was founded in 2006 and is specialised in Brazilian music and educational activities.
programme.title: Villa-Lobos - String Quartet No. 14

programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.
programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School

programme.desc: Agrippina is a fresh, exuberantly inventive opera and sets one of the finest librettos Handel has worked with. It was duly recorded under the baton of Arnold Östman, a renowned specialist in music of the 17th and 18th centuries.
programme.title: Handel - Agrippina

programme.desc: Christa Ludwig offers a last performance before taking her leave of the opera and concert stage. In a final Lieder recital honouring the city that has seen her greatest triumphs, she performs songs by Beethoven, Schubert, Mahler and Wolf. Recorded at the Wiener Musikverein in 1994.
programme.title: Christa Ludwig - Tribute to Vienna

programme.desc: Pianist Vadim Repin and Violist Murad Hüseynov perform Gara Garayev's Violin Sonata and 24 Preludes for Piano. Recorded at La Grange ay Lac. Written and directed by Juliette Swierczewski and recorded at La Grange au Lac. Although Garayev is a 20th century composer, his music nonetheless carries allusions to romantic music.
programme.title: Gara Garayev : Autumn Sonatas

programme.desc: In this splendid 2013 concert from the Church of Verbier, Switzerland, Greek violinist Leonidas Kavakos and Chinese pianist Yuja Wang join forces to interpret three sonatas of Johannes Brahms.
programme.title: Brahms - Violin Sonata No. 1, Op. 78

programme.desc: Soloist Christian Zacharias performs Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 8, K 246, accompanied by the Radio-Sinfonieorchester Stuttgart and conducted by Gianluigi Gelmetti. The concert took place in Schwetzingen Palace.
programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 8, K 246

programme.desc: House of Dreams is an imaginative concert designed by Alison Mackay. It is a magical journey to the meeting places of baroque art and music by Bach and Handel. The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra, who specialize in historical performance is directed by Jeanne Lamon.
programme.title: House of Dreams

programme.desc: Le Concert Spirituel plays a beautiful Handel program under the baton of Hervé Niquet at the Chambord Castle in France. The concert features Handel's Concerti Grossi, Water Music and Music for the Royal Fireworks.
programme.title: Handel at Chambord Castle

programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.
programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto

programme.desc: The documentary Summertime at the Domaine Forget introduces internationally renowned treasure: Domaine Forget festival in Saint-Irénée, Québec. Discover this annual summer festival that celebrates music and dance.
programme.title: Summertime at the Domaine Forget

programme.desc: Musicians of the Reina Sofía School of Music pay tribute to the rich musical heritage of Czechia in this chamber concert. The program features works by Bedřich Smetana, Leoš Janáček, Josef Suk and Antonín Dvořák. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on November 28, 2024.
programme.title: Works by Smetana, Janáček, Suk and Dvořák

programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam and the Nationaal Vrouwen Jeugdkoor in a performance of Gustav Holst’s The Planets, Op. 32, recorded at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000.
programme.title: Holst - The Planets

programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.
programme.title: Ravel - La Valse

programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birthday, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 12. Written in 1837, the work is a set of eight piano pieces with contrasting moods. The work’s title is derived from one of the composer’s favourite authors’ collection of novellas: E. T. A. Hoffmann’s Fantasiestücke in Callots Manier.
programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 12

programme.desc: As part of the ‘Da Camera’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, the Spanish Grupo Fundación Mutua Madrileña performs Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’, in an arrangement for chamber orchestra by conductor Francisco Alonso Serena. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on May 30, 2023.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 for chamber orchestra

programme.desc: Before Porpora, Scarlatti and Pergolesi ruled the Neapolitan music scene there was Gaetano Greco, one of the finest music teachers and composers of his day. Andrea Buccarella, a young harpsichordist from Rome (also performing in the Festival with his Abchordis Ensemble), pairs Greco’s most beautiful toccatas and famous Ballo di Mantua with works by his pupil Durante, who with his ‘quattro stagioni’ explores every nook and cranny of the keyboard.
programme.title: Naples, City of Keyboards - Gaetano Greco

programme.desc: In Tales of Two Cities, the Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra celebrates the music and culture in eighteenth century coffee houses of Leipzig and Damascus with works by Bach, Telemann, Handel and classical Arabic music. Recorded at the Aga Khan Museum in Toronto.
programme.title: Tales of Two Cities: Leipzig-Damascus Coffee House

programme.desc: Bruckner's Fifth Symphony has been called the "Medieval" because of its multi-layered, Baroque, contrapuntal tonal textures and the "Catholic" because of its solemn majesty. Franz Welser-Möst, Music Director of both The Cleveland Orchestra and the Zurich Opera, brought his U.S. ensemble to St. Florian in September 2006 for performances at the Linz Brucknerfest.
programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 5

programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Cerón (bariton).
programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana

programme.desc: The Valerius Ensemble, consisting of Eeva Koskinen (violin), René Geesing (cello) and Ingo Lulofs (piano) plays Rachmaninoff’s Trio élégiaque Nr.1 and the Finale of Dvořák’s Piano Trio No.3, Op. 65. Recorded in Muziekcentrum Enschede.
programme.title: Rachmaninoff & Dvořák Trios

programme.desc: Young Euro Classic is the world’s most important platform for international young orchestra musicians in the European classical music tradition, and for its development. This performance features some highlights of the Young Euro Classic edition of 2016.
programme.title: Mussorgsky - Night on Bald Mountain

programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55

programme.desc: The first edition of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM) was dedicated to the piano. As part of this competition, Leonardo Colafelice (Italy, 1995) performs Felix Mendelssohn’s Variations sérieuses, Op. 54, and Frédéric Chopin’s “Heroic” Polonaise in A-flat major, Op. 53. This performance was recorded at Nuovo Teatro Ariberto in Milan, in May, 2021.
programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final: Mendelssohn and Chopin

programme.desc: For years, the tension between the group and the individual has been the central theme in Platel’s performances. In C(H)ŒURS, so far his biggest project, he examines how ‘dangerously beautiful’ a group can be.
programme.title: C(h)oeurs

programme.desc: Johan de Meij conducts two of his own works: “Echoes of San Marco,” a tribute to Giovanni Gabrielli and “Fellini,” a tribute to film composer Federico Fellini. Saxophonist Hans de Jong is the soloist. Recorded at the Sala dei Teatini of the Teatri di Piacenza in 2018.
programme.title: Johan de Meij - Echoes of San Marco & Fellini

programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. As part of the festival’s 2021 edition, maestro Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program featuring Johannes Brahms’s Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81, and Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.
programme.title: Brahms - Tragic Overture in D minor Op. 81

programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52.
programme.title: Chopin - Nocturnes Op. 62

programme.desc: Bulgarian conductor Pavel Baleff conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Opéra de Limoges in a performance of Antonín Dvořák’s lyric fairytale opera Rusalka (1900). Stage director Nicola Raab and TV director Arnaud Lalanne created a truly filmic production of Dvořák’s masterpiece. Among the soloists are Ruzan Mantashyan, Adam Smith, Rafal Pawnuk, Marie-Adeline Henry, Marion Lebègue, and Alexandra Marcellier. This performance was recorded at the Opéra de Limoges, France, in February 2021.
programme.title: Dvořák - Rusalka

programme.desc: The Waldbühne in Berlin, one of the most appealing outdoor amphitheatres on the European continent, is the home of the Berliner Philharmoniker's summer concerts. This year Seiji Ozawa and the Berliner Philharmoniker perform works by George Gershwin.
programme.title: Waldbühne 2003 - A Gershwin Night

programme.desc: The Rina Sala Gallo International Piano Competition takes place every two years in the Italian city of Monza. This broadcast featuring the three finalists’ best performances from the competition’s 26th edition, were recorded at the Villa Reale di Monza in October 2022. The finalists are Young Sun Choi (South Korea, 1991), Seunghyuk Na (South Korea, 1997), and Ivan Bašić (Serbia, 1996).
programme.title: Rina Sala Gallo Piano Competition 2022 - Finalists

programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances’ string quartet – consisting of David Grimal (violin), Hans Peter Hofmann (violin), David Gaillard (viola), and Xavier Phillips (cello) – performs Franz Schubert’s String Quartet No. 15 in G major, D. 887, Op. 161. This performance was recorded at Cité de la Musique in Paris, France, in 2014.
programme.title: Schubert - String Quartet No. 15 in G major

programme.desc: This splendid Christmas concert recorded at the Freiburg cathedral in 1999 features soprano Barbara Bonney, baritone Matthias Goerne, the Freiburg Baroque Orchestra and the German Brass. The program includes works by Bach, Mozart, and Handel.
programme.title: Baroque Christmas Concert

programme.desc: In this broadcast, Angela Hewitt plays Preludes and Fugues Nos. 13 to 24 (BWV 882-893) from Book Two of Bach’s Well-Tempered Clavier, recorded at Wartburg in Eisenach, Germany, in 2010.
programme.title: Bach - Well-Tempered Clavier, Book II No. 13 to 24

programme.desc: Seen here in 2021 at one of Italy’s oldest extant Renaissance theatres, the gorgeous Teatro Olimpico in the northern Italian town of Vicenza, Costanza Principe (1993) performs Johann Sebastian Bach’s ‘Concerto italiano’ and ‘Ciaccona’, as transcribed for piano by Ferruccio Busoni.
programme.title: Bach – Italian Concerto & Chaconne (arr. Busoni)

programme.desc: In this exciting documentary, we go behind-the-scenes at the Zurich Opera House and follow the intensive progress of the new production of Gioachino Rossini's Il Barbiere di Siviglia with Vesselina Kasarova in the role of Rosina.
programme.title: Behind the Scenes at the Zurich Opera House

programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7. The majestic opening theme of the first movement of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7 foreshadows a momentous work, lasting over 20 minutes. The doubt and turmoil felt throughout the Adagio, the second movement, are supposedly Bruckner's response to the news of the death of his idol, Richard Wagner.
programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7

programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 2 in G major, Op. 18, No. 2; String Quartet No. 16 in F major, Op. 135; and String Quartet No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 131. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 2, 14 & 16

programme.desc: This documentary made in 2012 by Enrique Sánchez Lansch follows the 12 cellists of the Berlin Philharmonic, who since 1972 have been a staple of the international musical universe.
programme.title: The 12 Cellists - Documentary

programme.desc: Baritone Arvid Fagerfjäll (Sweden, 1991) and pianist Hikaru Kanki (Japan, 1993) perform works by Robert Schumann, Henriëtte Bosmans, Franz Schubert, Aribert Reimann, Jean Sibelius, Hugo Wolf, Francis Poulenc, André Caplet, and Claude Debussy, during the final round of the International Vocal Competition 2021 – Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at De Verkadefabriek in ’s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands.
programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Schumann, Sibelius a. o.

programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program. Under the direction of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of the Rings, Harry Potter, Highlander, and The Chronicles of Narnia. Featured soloists in this concert are Danish soprano Christine Nonbo Andersen, Korean percussionist Jihye Kim, Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Swedish bass Johan Karlström, and British actor David Bateson.
programme.title: Fantasymphony - One Concert to Rule Them All

programme.desc: Anton Bruckner's Symphony No. 9 can be seen as a farewell to life. The details of this architectural colossus are worked out with astonishing transparency by Franz Welser-Möst and the Cleveland Orchestra. Recorded live in late October 2007 at the magnificent "Golden Hall" of Vienna's fabled Musikverein where the work was given its premiere.
programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 9

programme.desc: Robert Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839. Bearing a dedication to Franz Liszt, it is one of Schumann's greatest works for solo piano, and a central work of the early Romantic period. Written in a loose sonata form, the first movement is rhapsodic and passionate, the middle movement is a grandiose rondo, and the finale is slow and meditative. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.
programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17

programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances present Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. This performance was recorded at Opéra de Dijon, France, in 2012.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55

programme.desc: Conducted by Andreas Spering, the South Netherlands Philharmonic performs Beethoven’s Sixth Symphony. Ludwig van Beethoven painted in his symphony the rustic idylls of a peasants’ picnic in the countryside, rife with murmuring brooks and a frightful thunderstorm.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6

programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048.
programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 3

programme.desc: The Waltz King is a docudrama with Lesley Garrett, an established star of the English National Opera, as narrator. The production offers an introduction to the Strauss dynasty, with an emphasis on domestic unhappiness and musical success.
programme.title: The Waltz King

programme.desc: On the occasion of its 75th anniversary on the 24th of December, 2011, the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra celebrates with a beautiful documentary about the orchestra and it's maestro's.
programme.title: Israel Philharmonic Orchestra: Coming Home

programme.desc: Gustavo Dudamel conducts the Paris Opera Orchestra and Choir in a performance of Giacomo Puccini’s La Bohème. Recorded at the Opéra National de Paris in 2017 and directed by Claus Guth.
programme.title: Puccini - La Bohème

programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker plays Tchaikovsky's Fantasy Overture from "Roméo et Juliette", Mozart is his famous Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major K. 216 with violinist Frank Peter Zimmermann and Stravinsky's The Rite of Spring.
programme.title: Stravinsky - Le Sacre - II: Le Sacrifice

programme.desc: The Valerius Ensemble, consisting of Robert Windak (violin), Michael Rein (violin), Eva Šušlíková (viola), Judith Chapman (cello) and Ingo Lylofs (piano), plays selections from Glières String Quartet Nr. 2 and Shostakovich’s Piano Quintet Op. 57.
programme.title: Glière, Op. 20 and Shostakovich, Op. 57

programme.desc: Das Rheingold is the prologue to Wagner's Ring cycle. With beautiful orchestration and an unerring sense of the dramatic, the first opera explains how the Rhinedaughters came to lose the Ring and how it fell into the hands of Alberich the Nibelung.
programme.title: Wagner - Das Rheingold

programme.desc: This performance was recorded during Mozart Week on January 27, 2006 in Salzburg, Austria, at the Großes Festspielhaus (Large Festival House) in celebration of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's 250th birthday. Under conductor Riccardo Muti, it features Thomas Hampson (baritone), Mitsuko Uchida (piano), Gidon Kremer (violin), Yuri Bashmet (viola), Wiener Singverein, and Wiener Philharmoniker.
programme.title: Festive Mozart Concert from Salzburg

programme.desc: This chamber music concert is part of the ‘Solistas del Siglo XXI’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid. First, Quinteto Zéphyros performs Leoš Janáček’s Mládí (‘Youth’) for wind sextet. This is followed by French flautist Paul Taffanel’s Wind Quintet in G minor, performed by Quinteto Scarlatti de Casa de la Moneda. The program closes with Sergei Prokofiev’s Quintet in G minor, Op. 39, played by Quinteto Cosan.
programme.title: Chamber music by Janáček, Taffanel and Prokofiev

programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Lily Maisky and Iddo Bar-Shaï, violinists Tedi Papavrami and Akiko Suwanai, her daughter Lyda Chen-Argerich on viola, and cellist Mischa Maisky. On the program are Felix Mendelssohn’s Piano Trio No. 1 in D minor, Op. 49; Leoš Janáček’s Violin Sonata; Franz Schubert’s Rondo in A major, D. 951; and Johannes Brahms’s Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60. These performances were recorded on May 4 and June 13, 2021.
programme.title: Schubert - Rondo D. 951

programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Samuel Barber’s Adagio for Strings. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Nacional in Mexico City, in 2021.
programme.title: Barber - Adagio for Strings

programme.desc: Gerd Albrecht conducts the Deutsche Kammerphilharmonie in a performance of Mozart’s “Prague” Symphony No. 38. Mozart composed the work in late 1786 and premiered it in January 1787, during the composer’s first visit to Prague, hence the nickname “Prague”.
programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 38, K. 504

programme.desc: Young Venezuelan conductor Glass Marcano is a rising star. In this concert, recorded at Opéra de Tours in February 2021, Marcano leads the Orchestre Symphonique Région Centre-Val de Loire/Tours in performances of two Romantic masterpieces. The program opens with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Violin Concerto in D major, Op. 61, featuring Stéphanie-Marie Degand as the soloist. The program concludes with Georges Bizet’s 1855 Symphony in C major.
programme.title: Beethoven Violin Concerto & Bizet Symphony in C

programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.
programme.title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov

programme.desc: In the summer of 2019, the Utrecht Early Music Festival explored the musical legacy of Naples: a cultural metropolis of contradiction and solidarity. In the documentary 'Napoli – Music’s Forgotten Capital', festival co-curator Thomas Höft unearths riveting tales from this multi-faceted city.
programme.title: Napoli - Music's forgotten capital -I

programme.desc: The lute in the limelight: no better opportunity to get a taste of 15th-century music for two lutes and soprano! These three musicians bring popular dances, chansons and cantus firmi from Burgundian repertoire back to life: the echo of popular music practice from the era of the mighty House of Valois.
programme.title: Two Lutes with Grace

programme.desc: Claudio Abbado: The Silence that Follows the Music offers a unique insight into the dedication of conductor Claudio Abbado. Through the eyes of musicians from several orchestras, this film expresses his commitment to music.
programme.title: Claudio Abbado: The Silence that Follows the Music

programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student. Inspired on the composer’s unrequited love for Irish actress Harriet Smithson, the five-movement piece portrays the dreams of a young artist who has taken an overdose of opium in the aftermath of a failed love affair. This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.
programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14

programme.desc: In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, Martha Argerich performs Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15 with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt. Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36, is also on the program. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15

programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. On the program are Prokofiev's Ouverture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34 and Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63, and Stravinsky's Jeu de Cartes and Firebird Suite No. 2.
programme.title: Stravinsky: Firebird Suite No. 2

programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. Soprano Claron McFadden features as the soloist, presenting a selection of Gershwin’s classic jazz songs. Pianist Bart Van Caenegem is the soloist in Gershwin’s celebrated Rhapsody in Blue. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.
programme.title: Gershwin - Greatest Hits

programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21

programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's The Nutcracker is one of the best known and most loved pieces of the composer, the music of which has inspired many choreographers to the tell the colourful Christmas fairytale of E. T. A. Hoffmann and Alexandre Dumas senior in the language of dance.
programme.title: Tchaikovsky - The Nutcracker

programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 2 in G major, Op. 18, No. 2; String Quartet No. 16 in F major, Op. 135; and String Quartet No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 131. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 14, Op. 131

programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87. The work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale. This performance was recorded at the Budapest Music Center, Hungary, in September 2023.
programme.title: Shostakovich - 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87

programme.desc: Hector Berlioz' Fantastic Symphony’ is widely regarded as one of the most important pieces of the early Romantic period. Leonard Bernstein once called it “the first musical expedition into psychedelia” because of its hallucinatory and dream-like nature.
programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Symphonie Fantastique

programme.desc: The Wild West meets the soulful sound of Italy. Fearless New York gangsters meet cowboys from the dusty prairie. And the magic of cinema meets the rich sound of a first-class symphony orchestra with this performance of soundtracks from Ennio Morricone, Nino Rota, Sonny Bono, and Bernard Herrmann.
programme.title: The Morricone Duel

programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the combined forces of the Music Academy KestonMAX fellows and London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Ludwig van Beethoven’s Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, and Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14. This concert was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s in London, UK, on November 20, 2022.
programme.title: Triple Concerto, Op. 56 & Symphonie Fantastique

programme.desc: Roger se inscribe con el Dr. P, quien usa métodos extraños pero efectivos, en un curso para mejorar su autoestima. Muy pronto, alumno y profesor entran en conflicto cuando se enamoran de la misma joven.
programme.title: Escuela de tontos
School for Scoundrels

programme.desc: Después de haber alcanzado en Europa un gran éxito profesional y mediático, un ex-jugador de fútbol venido a menos viaja a los Estados Unidos con la intención de reconciliarse con su ex-mujer y con su hijo.
programme.title: Jugando por amor
Playing for Keeps

programme.desc: Un joven rebelde abandona sus estudios y se alista en el ejército, sin saber qué hacer con su vida, hasta que conoce a la chica de sus sueños, Savannah, con la que mantendrá una irregular relación marcada por los acontecimientos.
programme.title: Querido John
Dear John

programme.desc: Para Holly la muerte de su marido ensombrece su futuro. Pero la aparición de varios mensajes en los que su esposo le explica cómo seguir adelante, serán el punto de partida para rehacer su vida.
programme.title: Posdata: te amo
PS I Love You

programme.desc: El coronel Claus Von Stauffenberg vuelve de África para unirse a la resistencia alemana, y organizar la Operación Valkiria. Él deberá liderar el golpe, tomar el control del gobierno de su país y matar al propio Hitler.
programme.title: Operación Valquiria
Valkyrie

programme.desc: Durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, en la Francia ocupada por los nazis, un grupo de soldados judío americanos, conocidos como Los Bastardos, son elegidos para sembrar miedo en el Tercer Reich, asesinando brutalmente a nazis.
programme.title: Bastardos sin gloria
Inglourious Basterds

programme.desc: Stanley Jobson, un experto en informática, es requerido por Gabriel Shear para que le ayude a decodificar un complicado código de seguridad. Jobson, exconvicto, planea usar su tajada para recuperar la custodia de su hija.
programme.title: Swordfish: acceso autorizado
Swordfish

programme.desc: Historia verídica de George Jung, un muchacho que no quiere seguir los pasos de su padre que se dedica a la construcción. Por tal motivo, viaja a California en busca de un futuro diferente, en el que la cocaína se vuelve su principal arma.
programme.title: Blow, profesión de riesgo
Blow

programme.desc: S1 E17 — Tolkien / After: aquí empieza todo / Escupiré sobre tu tumba 4: Déjà vu Te mostramos el detrás de escena de las películas: Tolkien, After: aquí empieza todo y Escupiré sobre tu tumba 4: Déjà vu.
programme.title: Hollywood on Set

programme.desc: S1 E18 — Vengadores: Endgame / Color rápido / Chicos buenos Conoce el detrás de escena y todos los detalles del set de las películas: Vengadores: Endgame, Color rápido y Chicos buenos.
programme.title: Hollywood on Set

programme.desc: S1 E19 — Toy Story 4 / Historias de miedo para contar en la oscuridad / Emanuel Conoce el set de filmación y todo el backstage de las películas: Toy Story 4, historias de miedo para contar en la oscuridad y Emanuel.
programme.title: Hollywood on Set

programme.desc: S1 E20 — La familia que tú eliges / Downton Abbey / Carnival Row Nos sumergimos en la creme de Hollywood, para conocer el set de filmación y su detrás de cámara, de las películas: La familia que tú eliges, Downton Abbey y Carnival Row.
programme.title: Hollywood on Set

programme.desc: Tras decirle a su esposa que sueña con la vida fácil que ella lleva en la casa, la mujer decide tomarse vacaciones para demostrarle lo contrario, por lo que Antoine tendrá que cuidar a los niños durante diez días.
programme.title: Mamá se va de viaje
10 jours sans maman

programme.desc: Paula es la directora de una revista para mujeres como ella: liberales, independientes y comprometidas. Las ventas no son buenas y, para salvar la publicación, se ve forzada a escribir una columna sobre las desventajas de la maternidad.
programme.title: No soy tu mami

programme.desc: Rupert Angier y Alfred Borden son dos magos de altos estándares que viven en Londres. Ambos han sido bendecidos con poderes espectaculares de decepción y ambos están condenados a una envidia permanente por las habilidades del otro.
programme.title: El gran truco
The Prestige

programme.desc: Luego de que sus padres son asesinados, el pequeño Bruce quiere tomar venganza. Tras un duro entrenamiento en el exterior, Bruce vuelve a ciudad Gótica para combatir el crimen y la corrupción, liberando a su alter ego: Batman.
programme.title: Batman inicia
Batman Begins

programme.desc: Con la ayuda del teniente Jim Gordon y el Fiscal del Distrito Harvey Dent, Batman tiene como objetivo destruir el crimen organizado en Ciudad Gótica. Ahora es el momento de enfrentar a la nueva mente criminal conocida como Joker.
programme.title: Batman: El caballero de la noche
The Dark Knight

programme.desc: Años después de que una plaga acabo con la mayor parte de la humanidad y transformó al resto en monstruosos mutantes, el único sobreviviente de Nueva York lucha valientemente por encontrar una cura.
programme.title: Soy leyenda
I Am Legend

programme.desc: En un mundo apocalíptico, un padre y su hijo viajan a la costa tratando de encontrar un lugar en donde asentarse y huir de un invierno interminable.
programme.title: El último camino
The Road

programme.desc: Treinta años después del "resplandor" que aniquiló casi toda la sociedad civilizada, unos pocos humanos sobreviven en un ambiente hostil y árido. Un guerrero solitario puede tener la clave para salvar a la humanidad en un extraño libro.
programme.title: El libro de los secretos
The Book of Eli

programme.desc: John es un antiguo asesino a sueldo que observa como un ladrón roba su coche y mata al perro que su mujer le regaló antes de morir. Tras el hecho, Jon persigue al delincuente y descubre una red mafiosa que le ha puesto un valor a su cabeza.
programme.title: John Wick

programme.desc: S2 E18 — Crónica de un asesino Una conmovedora historia de ficción que presenta la realidad de los latinos en el mundo actual. Los protagonistas toman decisiones trascendentales que les cambia su destino.
programme.title: Decisiones: unos ganan, otros pierden

programme.desc: S2 E55 — Tierra de nadie / Descuido fatal Nancy y María Elena viven entre el río Bravo y la frontera norteamericana. Desde allí, María Elena ayuda a los indocumentados a cruzar. / La hija de Pedro tiene trece años, pero solo cuando está con él, se comporta bien.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S2 E256 — Stripper menor de edad / No a la comida chatarra En su despedida de soltero, Félix contrató a dos strippers hermanas y una de ellas era menor de edad. / A David le queda poco tiempo de vida a causa de su obesidad, adquirida por la comida chatarra.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S2 E358 — La bigama / Subordinada Nikanol se casó en Venezuela, aunque al llegar a Estados Unidos, descubrió que su mujer se volvió a casar y luego falleció. Ahora, le reclama la herencia.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S2 E60 — La piñata / El blog oscuro Néstor se casó con la ex-esposa de su amigo Junior y se hizo cargo de su hija, pero ahora la mujer murió. / Andrés es un bloguero que fomenta en internet un juego muy peligroso.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S2 E61 — La sobreprotectora / Las dos bodas de Ángel Norma casó a su hijo con una cubana para obtener los papeles, pero de igual manera ellos se gustan. / Ángel fue novio de Alonso en la cárcel y aunque pensaban casarse, había una mujer entre ellos.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S1 E93 — En manos de un criminal Nuria llega al lugar donde la citó Braulio para reunirse con Andrés. Diego es acusado por la muerte de Celia. Andrés escucha que viajarán a Estados Unidos. Consuelo tiende una trampa a Fausto. Nuria comete un error que Braulio no tolera.
programme.title: Vuelve a mí

programme.desc: S1 E13 — Temporada 1 Episodio 13 Elena, presa de sus miedos, descubre que tiene una rival que quiere matarla desde más allá. Pero le llega ayuda del cielo para darle apoyo. Por otro lado, Rebeca descubre la infidelidad de Darío.
programme.title: El fantasma de Elena

programme.desc: S1 E14 — Temporada 1 Episodio 14 La policía y Eduardo interrogan a Latoña por la desaparición del cadáver. Laura trata de sacar a Elena de la casa. Elena tiene malestares y los resultados dicen que está embarazada. Latoña tiene el cadáver de Elena Calcaño.
programme.title: El fantasma de Elena

programme.desc: S1 E466 — Especial de banda Trajimos a la banda 'Los Obreros del Norte' porque estos guapísimos músicos demostrarán cuáles son sus habilidades para encontrar a su pareja ideal.
programme.title: 12 corazones

programme.desc: S1 E546 — Especial soltero codiciado El soltero más codiciado por todos, parece ser un joven bajo el signo de Géminis. ¿Cuál de todas las participantes logrará seducirlo y ganar una cita con él?
programme.title: 12 corazones

programme.desc: S1 E99 — Una viuda feliz Es el funeral de Pedro y Emilio asiste para prometer que lo reemplazará dignamente en la empresa con el cargo de presidente, pero su intención y el poder legal no son suficientes.
programme.title: La mujer de mi vida

programme.desc: S1 E100 — Repercusiones Daniela aclara que Ricardo en realidad está vivo. Entonces, aprovecha las cámaras para pedir ayuda. A su vez, el llamado es para quien tenga información que sea útil, para poder comprobar su inocencia.
programme.title: La mujer de mi vida

programme.desc: S1 E101 — Proyectos de vida Ricardo y Daniela están juntos otra vez, mientras Marcela le hace una visita inesperada a Emilio, aunque había rechazado por completo la idea y él está ansioso por oír su respuesta.
programme.title: La mujer de mi vida

programme.desc: S1 E102 — Loco por Daniela Emilio no mide sus limites y despliega un operativo, en el que participan sus cómplices para quedarse con Daniela. Luego, ella no responde el teléfono y no asiste a la cita con el empresario español, por lo que comienza a preocuparse.
programme.title: La mujer de mi vida

programme.desc: S1 E103 — Soñar no cuesta nada Un cómplice de Emilio, le trae un auto y un arma. Entonces, su plan se basa en ir al yate de Pedro y viajar por el mundo junto a Daniela.
programme.title: La mujer de mi vida

programme.desc: Un macho no muy barón Con una falimia con dos hijos, Raúl le oculta un secreto a su esposa Gabriela, que al develarse cambiará la vida de ambos.
programme.title: Decisiones: unos ganan, otros pierden

programme.desc: Profesora de química Nicolás es un estudiante que tiene problemas en su curso debido a su mal comportamiento y malas calificaciones, además, al joven le gusta molestar a una de sus profesoras, ya que parece tener sentimientos hacia ella.
programme.title: Decisiones: unos ganan, otros pierden

programme.desc: S1 E88 — La última noche Nuria cumple su palabra y lleva al niño a la mansión Zepeda. Entonces, Martha aprovecha para pedirle perdón. Por otro lado, Liana está tan descontrolada, que vuelca su furia hacia su única amiga. Además, detienen a Braulio.
programme.title: Vuelve a mí

programme.desc: S1 E93 — En manos de un criminal Nuria llega al lugar donde la citó Braulio para reunirse con Andrés. Diego es acusado por la muerte de Celia. Andrés escucha que viajarán a Estados Unidos. Consuelo tiende una trampa a Fausto. Nuria comete un error que Braulio no tolera.
programme.title: Vuelve a mí

programme.desc: S1 E94 — Es momento de rendir cuentas Braulio encierra a Nuria y escapa con Andrés. Santiago obtiene la dirección del hotel. Martha no puede creer en lo que se convirtió Braulio y Liana. Andrés logra convencer a Braulio de no escapar. Braulio toma una decisión equivocada.
programme.title: Vuelve a mí

programme.desc: S1 E91 — Fuego que purifica Fausto ejecuta el plan de Liana, las hermanas García están sentenciadas. Braulio escoge a su hijo.
programme.title: Vuelve a mí

programme.desc: S1 E92 — Una familia a la fuerza Braulio le hace a Nuria una oferta que no puede rechazar. Liana se entera de que la buscan.
programme.title: Vuelve a mí

programme.desc: S1 E95 — El día más feliz Liana fuera de sí comete un trágico error. En medio de una tristeza infinita, el funeral de Ray se lleva a cabo. Fausto encuentra su destino.
programme.title: Vuelve a mí

programme.desc: S2 E63 — Equivocado en la cama / Hijo de nadie Ricardo encontró a su esposa durmiendo con su mejor amiga y su hija en medio de ellas. / Omar pasó veintitres años en prisión y desde que salió, le enseña a su hijo a abrir autos ajenos.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S2 E40 — La cárcel de mis sueños / Estafa en el volcán Gonzalo está cansado de su mujer y tomó la decisión de asaltar un banco, para ir a prisión. / Ángela le vendió una casa al esposo de Natalia, pero el arreglo fue confuso.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S2 E41 — El desamparado / Madre violenta Para no ser una carga, Roberto decidió desaparecer, pero sus hijos quieren que regrese a casa. / José quiere el divorcio de Claudia y pelea la custodia de los hijos que tienen en común.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S2 E42 — Te toque el 4 / Enfermedad de hombres Lucía, tras diez años de relación, tiene a su pareja, Emilio, en muy malas condiciones de salud, pero ha aparecido la esposa legal que vivía en Venezuela que le ha quitado el derecho a cuidarlo y hasta se quiere quedar con la casa.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S2 E43 — Out al trapecio / Pobrezafilia Adelay es un pelotero que logró salir de Cuba, para jugar en las Grandes Ligas. Pero actualmente está lesionado. / Juan Carlos descubrió que su hijo se masturba con fotografías de Evelyn, su esposa.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S2 E244 — Meditación hot / Preso y sin opción María Luisa contrata una empresa de masajes corporales ardientes, pero en realidad no está conforme con el masajista. / Aníbal entra a prisión y su esposa quiere que renuncie a sus derechos como padre.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S2 E45 — Autista depredador / Que pague el asesino El hijo de Elizabeth y Omar es autista, pero ninguno quiere la custodia de Fidel por ser adicto al porno. / La madre de Vanesa muere y ella demanda a la esposa del amante de su mamá.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Furia de titanes
Clash of the Titans

programme.title: Sin límite
Limitless

programme.desc: Jim Hanson, un veterano de guerra, está pasando por un momento difícil, ya que su amada esposa acaba de fallecer y el banco está a punto de quitarle su casa. Hasta que aparecen a su vida una madre y su hijo, dos inmigrantes ilegales.
programme.title: El protector
The Marksman

programme.desc: Jonathon Cold es un agente especial retirado contratado por un misterioso hombre de negocios para realizar un envío desde Francia a Alemania. El contenido del paquete parece atraer a toda clase de políticos corruptos y asesinos a sueldo.
programme.title: El forastero
The Foreigner

programme.desc: El experto en seguridad Ray Breslin es contratado para rescatar a la hija de un magnate de la tecnología de Hong Kong que ha sido secuestrada y puesta bajo custodia en una prisión de Letonia.
programme.title: Plan de escape: El rescate
Escape Plan: The Extractors

programme.desc: En medio de un tiroteo, Smith, un pistolero misterioso y solitario, ayuda en el nacimiento de un bebé. Junto a una hermosa prostituta, intentará proteger a la inocente criatura de una peligrosa banda de criminales.
programme.title: La huida
Shoot 'em Up

programme.desc: Cuando Anastasia Steele, una estudiante de literatura, entrevista al millonario Christian Grey, se encuentra con un hombre hermoso, brillante e intimidante. Pronto se sienten atraídos y comienzan una relación con unos gustos singulares.
programme.title: Cincuenta sombras de Grey
Fifty Shades of Grey

programme.desc: Magic Mike viaja a Londres acompañado por una rica mujer de mundo para llevar a cabo su última actuación. ¿Estará Mike a la altura de lo que le propondrá?
programme.title: El último baile de Magic Mike
Magic Mike's Last Dance

programme.desc: Una niña fue abandonada en el locker número 10 de una estación del metro. Su suerte la lleva a vivir entre la miseria y la crueldad de una familia de mafiosos que la forma como una criminal que cumple las misiones que le asignan.
programme.title: La chica del casillero
Coin Locker Girl

programme.desc: La Mayor Susan Turner, líder de la antigua unidad militar de Reacher, es falsamente acusada de traición. Jack Reacher tendrá que sacarla de prisión y descubrir la verdad detrás de una conspiración gubernamental para salvar sus vidas.
programme.title: Jack Reacher: sin regreso
Jack Reacher 2: Never Go Back

programme.desc: Varios ex miembros de las fuerzas especiales son contratados por un jeque árabe para matar a unos miembros del Servicio Especial Aéreo británico, culpables de la muerte de tres de sus hijos durante unos disturbios en Omán diez años antes.

programme.desc: S8 E7 Narra la vida y los crímenes de la Unidad de Víctimas Especiales de élite del Departamento de Policía de Nueva York. Comandando la Unidad de Víctimas Especiales, se encuentra la teniente Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay), una veterana de la unidad que lo ha visto todo. Ella lidera con empatía y profesionalismo, mientras trata con su pasado difícil como producto de una violación y su futuro como madre de un niño pequeño, los cuales influyen en la forma en que se relaciona con las víctimas y los perpetradores de cada caso.
programme.title: Law & Order: SVU

programme.desc: S8 E8 Narra la vida y los crímenes de la Unidad de Víctimas Especiales de élite del Departamento de Policía de Nueva York. programme.title: Law & Order: SVU

programme.desc: S1 E13 Patrick Jane (Simon Baker), un consultor independiente del Departamento de Investigaciones de California, con un notable historial de resolución de crímenes graves utilizando solo sus habilidades de observación. Conocido por su flagrante falta de protocolo y su casi celebridad pasada como médium psíquico – cuyas habilidades paranormales ahora admite que fingió – el papel de Jane en descifrar una serie los casos difíciles de alto perfil son muy valorados por sus compañeros agentes. Sin embargo, la sensata agente Teresa Lisbon (Robin Tunney) se resiste abiertamente a tener a Jane en su unidad y alterna entre reconocer de mala gana la utilidad de Jane y criticarlo por sus actos de teatro, narcisismo y peligrosa falta de límites. El equipo de Lisbon incluye a los agentes Kimball Cho (Tim Kang), Wayne Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) y la novata Grace Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti), quienes creen que Jane es un cañón suelto, pero que admiran su encanto y habilidad para solucionar los casos.
programme.title: The Mentalist

programme.desc: S8 E7 Narra la vida y los crímenes de la Unidad de Víctimas Especiales de élite del Departamento de Policía de Nueva York. Comandando la Unidad de Víctimas Especiales, se encuentra la teniente Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay), una veterana de la unidad que lo ha visto todo. Ella lidera con empatía y profesionalismo, mientras trata con su pasado difícil como producto de una violación y su futuro como madre de un niño pequeño, los cuales influyen en la forma en que se relaciona con las víctimas y los perpetradores de cada caso.

programme.desc: S1 E15 Patrick Jane (Simon Baker), un consultor independiente del Departamento de Investigaciones de California, con un notable historial de resolución de crímenes graves utilizando solo sus habilidades de observación. Conocido por su flagrante falta de protocolo y su casi celebridad pasada como médium psíquico – cuyas habilidades paranormales ahora admite que fingió – el papel de Jane en descifrar una serie los casos difíciles de alto perfil son muy valorados por sus compañeros agentes. Sin embargo, la sensata agente Teresa Lisbon (Robin Tunney) se resiste abiertamente a tener a Jane en su unidad y alterna entre reconocer de mala gana la utilidad de Jane y criticarlo por sus actos de teatro, narcisismo y peligrosa falta de límites. El equipo de Lisbon incluye a los agentes Kimball Cho (Tim Kang), Wayne Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) y la novata Grace Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti), quienes creen que Jane es un cañón suelto, pero que admiran su encanto y habilidad para solucionar los casos.
programme.title: The Mentalist

programme.desc: S1 E11 Patrick Jane (Simon Baker), un consultor independiente del Departamento de Investigaciones de California, con un notable historial de resolución de crímenes graves utilizando solo sus habilidades de observación. Conocido por su flagrante falta de protocolo y su casi celebridad pasada como médium psíquico – cuyas habilidades paranormales ahora admite que fingió – el papel de Jane en descifrar una serie los casos difíciles de alto perfil son muy valorados por sus compañeros agentes. Sin embargo, la sensata agente Teresa Lisbon (Robin Tunney) se resiste abiertamente a tener a Jane en su unidad y alterna entre reconocer de mala gana la utilidad de Jane y criticarlo por sus actos de teatro, narcisismo y peligrosa falta de límites. El equipo de Lisbon incluye a los agentes Kimball Cho (Tim Kang), Wayne Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) y la novata Grace Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti), quienes creen que Jane es un cañón suelto, pero que admiran su encanto y habilidad para solucionar los casos.
programme.title: The Mentalist

Conocido por su flagrante falta de protocolo y su casi celebridad pasada como médium psíquico – cuyas habilidades paranormales ahora admite que fingió – el papel de Jane en descifrar una serie los casos difíciles de alto perfil son muy valorados por sus compañeros agentes. Sin embargo, la sensata agente Teresa Lisbon (Robin Tunney) se resiste abiertamente a tener a Jane en su unidad y alterna entre reconocer de mala gana la utilidad de Jane y criticarlo por sus actos de teatro, narcisismo y peligrosa falta de límites. El equipo de Lisbon incluye a los agentes Kimball Cho (Tim Kang), Wayne Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) y la novata Grace Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti), quienes creen que Jane es un cañón suelto, pero que admiran su encanto y habilidad para solucionar los casos.
programme.title: The Mentalist

programme.desc: S9 E6 Investigando el espectacular accidente aéreo del "Golden Parachute". Horatio Caine (David Caruso) y su equipo de hábiles investigadores salen a las calles, playas y pantanos de Miami con un dulce Humvee y la capacidad de arrestar a sus sospechosos (un poder que sus contrapartes de Las Vegas no poseen).

programme.desc: S8 E13 Narra la vida y los crímenes de la Unidad de Víctimas Especiales de élite del Departamento de Policía de Nueva York. Comandando la Unidad de Víctimas Especiales, se encuentra la teniente Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay), una veterana de la unidad que lo ha visto todo. Ella lidera con empatía y profesionalismo, mientras trata con su pasado difícil como producto de una violación y su futuro como madre de un niño pequeño, los cuales influyen en la forma en que se relaciona con las víctimas y los perpetradores de cada caso.

programme.title: Macario

programme.desc: Gumaro es un norteño atrabancado que carga con culpas de balaceras y bravuconerías. Ningún alguacil ha podido con él y por ello traen a un contrincante de Jalisco, a ver quién puede más.
programme.title: De tal palo tal astilla

programme.desc: Ángel y Javier le sacan a la vida más de lo que ella les puede dar, estafando a todo el que se les pusiera enfrente. Pero se encontrarán con otros como ellos.
programme.title: Fuerte, audaz y valiente

programme.desc: Clara, quien sufre de ceguera, está infelizmente casada con Juan Manuel, un mujeriego que le es infiel y que solo está con ella por su fortuna. Juan Manuel intenta que su esposa acepte firmar su testamento a su favor, aunque ella se niega.
programme.title: Pecado mortal

programme.desc: Recién regresado de EEUU, Agustín evita trabajar y casarse con Lupita, que se va a México como cantante. Él va a buscarla, pero un golpe en la cabeza provoca que olvide y recuerde a la mujer intermitentemente.
